posted_text:
🤰 Reproductive Rights
MI SB 0415 — Michigan Could Expand Coverage for Group Prenatal Care

Starting when this new rule takes effect, Michigan’s Medicaid program will cover group prenatal care services. These services would include up to 12 visits in a group setting, following an evidence-based model, and must involve at least three people. ...
